name: Default
shortDescription: Self-hosted Telegram file downloader with a web UI, multi-account support and rule-based automatic downloads, stored in SQLite.

alerts.message: The stack starts with placeholder Telegram credentials, so adding an account fails until you set TELEGRAM_API_ID and TELEGRAM_API_HASH from your own Telegram application, then redeploy.

On first start the container log prints a one-time bootstrap code valid for 15 minutes. Enter it in the web UI to create the administrator account; restart the service to get a new code if it expires.
